audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradicted their own why-strings: rows 1 and 2 were given to Shen while whys[1]/whys[2]/spikes[0] all say levels 2-3 are Kled's window; row 0 was 'Skill' while whys[0] says Shen chips you for free; row 4 was 'Skill' while whys[4] and spikes[1] call level 6 Kled's spike.
audit.why: Shen's level-1 Twilight Assault does max-health damage with a Ki Barrier shield on every cast and Kled has no poke; at 2-3 Violent Tendencies plus the full re-E beats a Shen who cannot yet hold W for it; at 6 Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! is a solo engage his global R does not answer.
audit.corrected: Rows 0/1/2/4 flipped to Shen/Kled/Kled/Kled as paired full+content rows. The result matches the packet chart exactly (Shen, Kled, Kled, Skill, Kled, Shen, Shen).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claimed Spirit's Refuge 'zeroes every auto for ~1.5s'.
audit.why: The duration is not in Riot's text and I could not verify it, but the cooldown is: 16s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5. That is the number the advice actually needs.
audit.corrected: Duration claim replaced with the 16s cooldown; the bait-then-commit timing is now concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text never stated the limit on Spirit's Refuge, and credited Shen with 'sustain'.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS near the spirit blade — Kled's Bear Trap and both halves of Jousting still land through it; only Violent Tendencies (four autos) is blanked. Shen has no heal at all: Ki Barrier is a shield he re-earns by casting, which is why he wins long trades without ever out-sustaining you. Shadow Dash is 600 range on 18s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The attacks-not-abilities rule now appears in early, report[5], breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[0]; 'sustain' replaced with Ki Barrier in whys[3] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0] ('Auto into his W') and dontsFull[1] ('Get taunted mid-trade') both carried generic template bodies that did not describe their own titles.
audit.why: Template copy-paste; the body under 'Get taunted mid-trade' was about wasting Q on the wave.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to the actual mistake.

edits.before: Level 1 you concede — preserve Skaarl's mount HP since Shen's empowered Q (Twilight Assault) and dash chip you for free, and you have no poke to answer. But 2 and 3 are yours: the moment your W shotgun shots and full re-E (E through, W procs, E back) come online, dive him before his W is a reliable block. The whole trick is his W (Spirit's Refuge) — it zeroes every auto for the duration, so never dump your W shots into an up Spirit's Refuge. Bait it empty, then commit.
edits.after: Level 1 you concede — Twilight Assault deals max-health damage and Ki Barrier shields him on every cast while you have no poke to answer, so preserve Skaarl's mount HP. But 2 and 3 are yours: the moment Violent Tendencies and the full re-E (E through, four attacks, E back) come online, dive him before he can hold W for it. The trick is Spirit's Refuge — it blocks attacks, not abilities, so Bear Trap and both Jousting hits land through it. Bait it, then dump the autos.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 swing back to Shen — his W block plus Q empower lets him eat your re-E and trade it back, and your remount damage doesn't out-pace his sustain the way it does a stat-checker. At 6 you spike: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! knocks him into your tower or pins him for a gank, and that's a window his global R can't peel from across the map. Force your all-in on his W cooldown, not into it — if Spirit's Refuge is up, you're just feeding free Courage with no payout.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 swing back to Shen — Spirit's Refuge plus Twilight Assault lets him eat your re-E and trade it back, and Ki Barrier re-shields him on every cast while you only bank Courage. At 6 you spike: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! rams him into your tower or pins him for a gank, and that's a window his global R can't peel from across the map. Force your all-in on the 16-second W cooldown, not into it — with Refuge up your autos do nothing.

edits.before: This tilts to Shen and you have to respect that. He scales evenly, his W blanks your on-hit DPS in every extended fight, and his taunt interrupts your E and R engages on demand. Worse, his global R means even when you win the side lane he's swinging bot for a kill. Your only real plan is the snowball you built at 2-3 and 6 — close the map or push so hard he can't ult away, because in a straight late trade his block plus your falling-off burst means you don't kill him.
edits.after: This tilts to Shen and you have to respect that. He scales evenly, Spirit's Refuge blanks your attacks in every extended fight, and Shadow Dash taunts you out of your own combo from 600 range. Worse, his global R means even when you win the side lane he's swinging bot for a kill. Your only real plan is the snowball you built at 2-3 and 6 — close the map or push so hard he can't ult away, because in a straight late trade his block plus your falling-off burst means you don't kill him.

notes: 'W shotgun shots' for Kled's W appears again here — W is Violent Tendencies (four fast attacks); the shotgun is the dismounted Pocket Pistol. This is now the third matchup in my slice with that error, so it is champion-wide and worth a name sweep. Not asserted: whether Shen's taunt can interrupt Kled's R charge mid-flight — the old text claimed it 'interrupts your E and R engages on demand' and nothing in Riot's description supports or denies it, so I softened it to the taunt's range instead of keeping the claim.
